q: Which country does this flag belong to?
intro: Welcome to Quiz Rush! Today it's all about flags. Forty national flags are hiding behind a puzzle, and the pieces flip one by one. You have ten seconds each. Ready? Let's play!
outro: And that's the last flag! How many did you get? Drop your score in the comments, and come back tomorrow, there's a brand new quiz every day on Quiz Rush!
